result.instructions: Tools for TicketSpice, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many tickets did we sell for the fall concert this week, and what revenue is that?"; "Show the attendee list for my event with check-in (scan) status."; "Find all orders and tickets bought with jane@example.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TicketSpice data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ticketspice_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ticketspice_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ticketspice_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. ticketspice_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ticketspice_list_forms
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the account's TicketSpice forms (ticketed events / order pages): id, name, status (open, closed, scheduled or archived), created and updated dates. Use the form ids to filter orders, tickets and transactions. GET /forms.

created_after.description: Only records created after this time.

created_before.description: Only records created before this time.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time.

updated_before.description: Only records updated before this time.

starting_after.description: Cursor: pass the previous reply's next_starting_after to get the next page.

sort.description: Sort by id: asc or desc (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: ticketspice_get_form
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One form by id: name, status, accounting reference, time zone and its field layout. GET /forms/{id}.

tools.name: ticketspice_get_form_inventory
tools.title: Get form inventory
tools.description: Inventory items of a form (limited-quantity items): path, name, sold and remaining quantity. GET /forms/{id}/inventory.

tools.name: ticketspice_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (one per checkout): order number, buyer billing name and address, form, total, currency and status, newest or oldest first. Filter by event (form), status, buyer email, customer id, order number or dates. GET /search/orders.

status.description: Order status string as the vendor returns it (for example "completed" or "active").

email.description: Only orders placed with this email address.

customer_id.description: Only orders of this customer (buyer) id.

order_number.description: Only the order with this order number.

tools.name: ticketspice_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id with the buyer's billing details, event, totals and status. Set include_tickets to embed the order's tickets and include_transactions its payments (charges and refunds). GET /search/orders/{id}.

tools.name: ticketspice_list_transactions

tools.description: List payment transactions (money movements): amount, currency, type (charge, refund, voucher), payment method, masked card, status, form and buyer email. Filter by type, method, form, order, donor or dates. GET /search/transactions.

status.description: Transaction status string as the vendor returns it (for example "completed" or "active").

order_id.description: Only transactions of this order id.

customer_id.description: Only transactions of this customer (buyer) id.

email.description: Only transactions of orders placed with this email.

order_number.description: Only transactions of this order number.

reference.description: Only the transaction with this payment reference (txReference).

tools.name: ticketspice_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One transaction by id: amounts, type, payment method, masked card, gateway message and status. GET /search/transactions/{id}.

Filter by event (form), status, order, buyer email, customer id or dates. Use it for attendee lists and check-in status. GET /search/tickets.

status.description: Ticket status string as the vendor returns it (for example "completed" or "active").

order_id.description: Only tickets of this order id.

order_display_id.description: Only tickets of the order with this customer-facing order display id.

customer_id.description: Only tickets of this customer id.

email.description: Only tickets of orders placed with this email address.

order_number.description: Only tickets of this order number.

tools.name: ticketspice_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: One ticket by id: buyer, event, level, amount, fee, total, status, scan count, last scan time and the buyer's form answers. GET /search/tickets/{id}.

tools.name: ticketspice_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer record by id: email, billing details and total of the customer's transactions. GET /search/customers/{id}.

customer_id.description: TicketSpice customer id (from ticketspice_list_customers, or an order's customerId).

tools.name: ticketspice_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List TicketSpice coupons: account-wide ones, or only those of one form when form_id is given. Shows discounts, codes, availability, redeemed count and expiry. GET /coupons/global or /coupons/forms/{id}.

form_id.description: Only coupons of this form; omit for the account-wide (global) coupons.

code.description: Only global coupons with this code (ignored with form_id).

starting_after.description: Cursor: pass the previous reply's next_starting_after to get the next page.

sort.description: Sort by id: asc or desc (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: ticketspice_get_coupon
tools.title: Get coupon
tools.description: One coupon by id with its discounts, codes, availability and redeemed counts. GET /coupons/{id}.

tools.name: ticketspice_create_coupon
tools.title: Create coupon
tools.description: WRITE: create a discount coupon in the live TicketSpice account (it can be redeemed by ticket buyers right away). One discount (fixed amount or percent) and one or more codes; optionally limited to one form, to a number of uses, and to an expiry date. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two coupons. POST /coupons.

discount_value.description: Discount amount: currency units for a fixed discount, percent (1-100) for a percent discount.

available.description: How many times the coupon can be used; -1 = unlimited (default).

form_id.description: Restrict the coupon to this form; omit for all forms.

per_ticket.description: Apply the discount to each ticket instead of once per order (default false).

expires.description: When the coupon expires; omit for no expiry.

tools.name: ticketspice_delete_coupon
tools.title: Delete coupon
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete a coupon from the live TicketSpice account; its codes stop working immediately and this cannot be undone. Show the coupon (ticketspice_get_coupon) and get the user's approval first, then call with confirm: true. GET /coupons/{id}, then DELETE /coupons/{id}.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved permanently deleting this coupon.
